# S6 DR results (generated by experiments/s6_kaggle_dr/summarize_dr.py)

Method: DecompositionReason (upstream a24953c), `decompose_num` = 5, greedy, divide/solve/merge caps 200/200/64 tokens. Slice `s306.json`: 306 questions, seed 0, 34 per hop (2-10), all 12 users; leak-free subset 140 (any-number rule). Intervals: 95% percentile bootstrap over questions (2000 resamples); paired differences use the same questions on both sides and are reported with the shared-question n.

## Calls and wall time

- DR SparseRAG: 1802 calls, 1097511 prompt + 30995 completion tokens, 37865s summed request time, 306 rows.
- DR DenseRAG: 1800 calls, 1136907 prompt + 31019 completion tokens, 39349s summed request time, 306 rows.
- DecompositionReason_SparseRAG_k20: wall 1006.8s, rows 306, failures 0, stopped=None.
- DecompositionReason_DenseRAG_k20: wall 1043.8s, rows 306, failures 0, stopped=None.

## Caveats

- One slice (306 questions), one seed, one 4-bit 7B model on a T4: exploratory, not a reproduction of the paper's A800/full-precision tables.
- DR makes 3-7 calls per question versus 1 for NR and 5 for SR, so the comparison is of complete methods, not of equal compute.
- The Kaggle vLLM/torch versions are recorded in `manifest_out.json`; the historical Colab versions were not pinned, so small decoding differences cannot be excluded. Greedy decoding is used on both sides.
- Intervals are percentile bootstraps over questions; no multiple-comparison correction is applied to the exploratory subset table.
